text:
maria: Quick sync — need final plan for DP beta recruitment + feedback ops. Target: 20 partners, 4-week cycles, staggered starts. Need intake form, compensation tiers, rolloff criteria. @devin can you confirm eng capacity for integration support? cc @sam for UX hooks.

devin: We can support 8 active partners in month 1, scale to 20 with staggered start weeks. Need a lightweight onboarding doc, a troubleshooting runbook, and one dedicated on-call window per week.

sam: UX can supply two task templates for structured feedback (usability + prompt-quality). Recommend weekly 15m show-and-tell + async Looms for demos. Keep surveys < 6 Qs.

ashok: From CS: acceptance = 70% active usage + 20% feature adoption. Also require an SLA to respond to partner blockers within 48h. We should log every partner issue into a shared tracker.

juno: Intake form suggestion — minimal fields so we don't lose applicants. Proposed snippet: 
```
- Org name
- Primary contact (email + timezone)
- Company size
- Primary use-case (1-2 lines)
- Expected monthly tokens / scale
- Data sensitivity (public / internal / regulated)
- SSO required? Y/N
- NDA checkbox
```

maria: Good set. For compensation tiers thinking: 1) Early credits $5k equivalent, 2) Pilot discount for first 3 months, 3) Co-marketing for standout partners. Keep legal short — NDA required, but no complex contracts initially.

devin: Ops note — we need a canary rollout policy for any model or infra change during the pilot. If we see a quality regression > 5% on the partners' eval set, pause rollout and notify partners. Also allocate a "rescue" capacity for degraded cases.

sam: For the feedback loop, propose: structured evals (weekly automated prompt set), a Notion scoreboard (latency, error rate, quality delta), and a single weekly digest. We should also capture open-text anecdotes in a shared doc.

ashok: Draft success checklist idea: onboarding completed < 5 business days, average latency < 200ms p50, NPS >= 8 at week 4, feature adoption >= 20% of driven flows. If any metric fails by week 6, offer remediation plan or pilot refund.

maria: Next actions: @devin — onboarding + runbook draft by Tue COB; @sam — feedback templates + scoreboard by Wed; @ashok — SLA + compensation terms draft by Fri. I'll draft outreach email and screening rubric. :rocket:

feedback-bot: Reminder: thread assigned to project 'dp-recruitment'. Deadlines added to project board.

maria: Thanks all. If drafts look good we'll sync Tue 10am for a 30min alignment call.
